Metadata.title: Untungin — Calculate COGS & Business Profit
Metadata.description: Calculate COGS, selling prices, operating costs, and your business profit with ease.

Landing.heading: Know whether your business makes money from day one.
Landing.intro: Calculate COGS from ingredients, operating costs, and equipment depreciation. Get the right selling price and see when you'll earn your capital back — no accounting knowledge needed.

hpp.title: Automatic COGS
hpp.body: Enter ingredients and amounts; the cost per portion is calculated instantly.

price.title: The right price
price.body: Price suggestions for your target margin, including GoFood & marketplace fees.

profit.title: Profit & payback
profit.body: See monthly profit, daily sales targets, and when your capital comes back.

StoreFields.targetMarginHint: A 40% margin means 40% of the selling price is profit. That differs from a 40% markup (price = cost + 40%), which only gives a margin of about 29%.

Channels.title: Sales channels
Channels.intro: Where you sell: offline, food delivery apps or marketplaces. Commission and per-order fees are used to calculate what you actually receive.
Channels.name: Channel name
Channels.feeHint: A fixed deduction per order, such as a service fee. Enter 0 if none.
Channels.templatesHint: Estimates as of October 2026, excluding VAT. Check the exact numbers in your merchant dashboard and edit them if needed.
Channels.templateExists: {name} is already one of your channels.
Channels.deleteWarning: Deleting a channel also deletes product prices and packaging used only in this channel.
Channels.lastChannel: The last channel can't be deleted. Add another channel first.

Dashboard.needSales: Fill in prices and sales estimates
Dashboard.paybackUnknown: Not profitable yet, so no payback
Dashboard.paybackNoCapital: Add your inventory to calculate payback
Dashboard.calcError: A composition row in {product} uses a unit that doesn't match its material, so the numbers can't be calculated yet.

Settings.title: Store settings
Settings.deleteWarning: All materials, products, costs, inventory, and analyses in this store will be permanently deleted. Type <name>{storeName}</name> to continue.
Settings.confirmLabel: Type the store name to confirm

Common.deleteConfirm: Delete this for sure? This can't be undone.

Materials.title: Materials & packaging
Materials.intro: Everything you buy to make your products: ingredients and packaging.
Materials.name: Material name
Materials.wasteHint: The part you throw away, such as peel or spills. Leave empty if none.
Materials.emptyBody: Record the ingredients and packaging you buy. E.g. Sugar, 1 kg, Rp15,000.

Expenses.title: Operating costs
Expenses.intro: Running costs besides materials: rent, electricity, wages and more.
Expenses.name: Cost name
Expenses.oneTimeHint: One-off costs such as a promotion: choose "per year", or split it per month yourself.
Expenses.ownerSalaryHint: Also add a salary for yourself (category "Your own salary"), so the profit you see isn't misleading.
Expenses.emptyBody: E.g. stall rent Rp1,500,000 per month, electricity Rp300,000 per month.

Assets.title: Inventory
Assets.intro: Business equipment: tables, chairs, stoves, freezers. The total is used as your starting capital.
Assets.name: Item name
Assets.usefulLifeHint: Roughly how long the item lasts. E.g. 24 months for a blender, 60 months for a freezer.
Assets.depreciationHint: The value the items lose each month. Counted as a fixed cost.
Assets.emptyBody: E.g. Wooden table, 2 pieces, Rp350,000, useful life 60 months.

Composition.title: Composition
Composition.intro: Materials and packaging for this product. 1 recipe = {yield} units.
Composition.empty: No materials in the composition yet. Add the first one below.
Composition.noMaterials: No materials to choose from yet.
Composition.channelHint: Pick one channel for packaging used only there, e.g. bubble wrap only for online orders.

Products.title: Products
Products.intro: The products you sell. Open a product to fill in its composition and price.
Products.name: Product name
Products.yieldHint: How many portions or units does one batch (one recipe) make? E.g. 10 cups.
Products.targetMarginHint: Leave empty to use the store target ({pct}).
Products.emptyBody: Add the products you sell, then fill in their materials. E.g. Iced milk coffee, 1 recipe = 10 cups.

Pricing.title: Price & cost
Pricing.intro: Selling price and expected sales per channel. Cost and margin are calculated for you.
Pricing.fullCostUnknown: Full cost appears once there is a sales estimate.
Pricing.marginHint: Margin = profit as a percentage of the selling price (not markup). Full cost includes operating costs and depreciation.
Pricing.previewEmpty: Enter a selling price to see cost and margin.
Pricing.inactivePreview: This product is not on sale, so it isn't counted on the dashboard.
Pricing.noComposition: This product has no composition yet, so its material cost is Rp0. Fill in the composition first.
Pricing.calcError: A composition row uses a unit that doesn't match its material. Fix the composition so the cost can be calculated.
Pricing.competitorHint: The price of a similar product elsewhere, for comparison.
Pricing.recommendationNoOverhead: Doesn't include operating costs yet — fill in expected sales for a better estimate.
Pricing.recommendationImpossible: Commission + target margin are too high: no sensible price satisfies this. Lower the target margin or use another channel.

Simulation.title: Simulation
Simulation.intro: Try other material prices, sales or selling prices. Nothing is saved — your real data stays as it is.
Simulation.perMaterialHint: Leave empty to follow "All material prices".
Simulation.shareHint: This page's address keeps the simulation settings, so you can reopen or share it.
Simulation.emptyBody: First give a product its composition, a price and expected sales.
Simulation.calcError: A composition row uses a unit that doesn't match its material. Fix it on the product page first.

Warnings.NET_LOSS: Your business loses money each month: fixed costs are higher than gross profit.
Warnings.LOSS_PRODUCTS: Loses money on every sale: {products}. Raise the price or lower material costs.
Warnings.NEGATIVE_CONTRIBUTION: On average every sale loses money. The more you sell, the bigger the loss.
Warnings.NO_OWNER_SALARY: Profit looks bigger because your own salary has not been counted.
Warnings.COMPETITOR_GAP: Price differs from competitors by more than 25%: {products}.
Warnings.NO_SALES_ESTIMATE: Fill in your monthly sales estimate so profit and break-even can be calculated.

Checklist.title: Getting started
Checklist.intro: Complete these steps so your numbers are accurate.
